subject.title: Talk: add context-aware durable voice sessions

question: After the cross-run confirmation defect is fixed, should core Talk adopt this durable voice-session, transcript-persistence, and twelve-option configuration surface?
rationale: The branch introduces permanent Gateway methods, persisted session behavior, operator-facing policy, and multiple configuration knobs; implementation review cannot decide whether that breadth is the intended core Talk product contract.

options.title: Narrow and sponsor
options.body: Approve the durable-session direction after confirmation is run-scoped, the configuration surface is reduced, iOS compiles, and real Browser/iPhone proof is attached.

options.title: Pause the core expansion
options.body: Keep existing realtime Talk behavior and split or close this branch until maintainers choose a smaller durable-session contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow and sponsor
recommendation.body: Approve the durable-session direction after confirmation is run-scoped, the configuration surface is reduced, iOS compiles, and real Browser/iPhone proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to prior Talk implementation review and adjacent realtime/Gateway work.
